risks.risk: Disc may be missing, cracked, or heavily scratched (may not install or may fail during play).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc (both sides) plus a short video showing the PS4 recognizing the disc in the console menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: disc not guaranteed to work (treated as not working until tested).

risks.risk: Region/compatibility issue (e.g., not matching the buyer’s PS4 region) or account/installation restrictions.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the back cover showing region/compatibility markings and the barcode/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: compatibility not confirmed.

risks.risk: Case/booklet damage or missing inserts (reduces value even if disc works).
risks.proof: Photos of the full case front/back and inside tray, showing whether any booklet/inserts are present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: missing inserts or damaged packaging.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the disc (front and back) in the tray.
Send a short video of a PS4 booting and showing the game recognized/installed from the disc.
Send a close-up of the back cover (barcode/serial and any region/compatibility markings).
Send photos of the inside tray and whether any booklet/inserts are included.
response.reason: The game title and PS4 case are visible, but the photo does not confirm the disc condition or whether it works on a PS4. For a disc-based item, that missing proof is what determines the real price.
